entries.02c8bb109d0ebbfa: This is a restaurant operation business carried out by the company, its consolidated subsidiary Sushi Tsune Co., Ltd., Ichiban Foods Inc. in the United States, and others. It operates restaurants including “Oyogi Torafugu Ryori Senmonten Torafugu-tei,” “Oishii Sushi to Kakkyo Ryori Uo no Meshi” and “Umai Sushi to Sakana Ryori Gyō ＫＵＮＩ” on a direct-operated and franchise basis. Sushi Tsune Co., Ltd. runs sushi restaurants with resident chefs under the “Sushi Tsune” brand, and Ichiban Foods Inc. runs the seafood restaurant “WOKUNI” in New York. Its main ingredients are purchased from consolidated subsidiary Nagasaki Farm Co., Ltd. Revenue from external customers in the fiscal year ended September 2025 was ¥6,534 million, making it the core of the group as a whole. As of September 30, 2025, the group had 63 stores.

entries.ad407626e29ec414: This is a business in which consolidated subsidiary Nagasaki Farm Co., Ltd. sells live and fresh fish, including its own farmed fish, to corporate and individual customers. It farms torafugu, bluefin tuna, hiramasa and others in Hirado, Nagasaki Prefecture, and processes and sells mikiri fugu (fugu with toxins removed) and others at a processing plant in Koto Ward, Tokyo. It is the first restaurant company to farm bluefin tuna, and it has branded its product under the name “Hirado Honmaguro Gokai Ichiban.” Revenue from external customers in the fiscal year ended September 2025 was ¥683 million.
entries.b90360ea06767fb9: This is a business in which the company and its consolidated subsidiary Sushi Tsune Co., Ltd. own residential properties and leased commercial facilities in Tokyo and other areas and earn rental income.
